info.title: OpenAI-compatible Batch API
info.description: OpenAI's Files and Batches routes over file orders, for the official OpenAI SDKs (base_url https://app.reliqua.ai/api/openai/v1) or plain HTTP. A batch is a dataset order on its input file, quoted and placed in one call, on a public Hugging Face model pinned at an exact commit; every sample follows the public seeded draw and is audited before delivery. Errors use OpenAI's shape. The native routes (generation contract: /api/v1/files and /api/v1/dataset-orders) serve the same orders and add quotes before ordering, uploads over 32 MiB, Parquet deliveries and evaluation scores. Contracts do not guarantee live ordering or capacity.

post.description: Quotes the file and orders it in one call; the response is the batch object. The reserved price is charged from your balance; at delivery the completion-token part of unverified tokens is refunded. Send an Idempotency-Key so a retried request returns the same batch (the OpenAI SDK retries automatically: pass it with extra_headers). To see a price first without reserving anything, quote the file on POST /api/v1/dataset-orders/quotes.

parameters.description: Replays the batch it created; the same key with another body is 409 idempotency_conflict.

workspaceKey.description: Account workspace key with orders:write (the OpenAI SDK api_key). Expiry, revocation, account access and ownership remain server checks.

Error.description: OpenAI's error shape. code keeps the platform's error code; type is authentication_error (401), not_found_error (404), rate_limit_error (429), server_error (5xx) or invalid_request_error.

FileUpload.description: multipart/form-data with Content-Length; the file is at most 33,554,432 bytes (32 MiB). Larger files use the native multi-part upload (POST /api/v1/files), whose files this API also reads.

file.description: The JSONL file; its name must match [A-Za-z0-9_.() -]{1,200} and not start with a period.

File.description: An input file (purpose batch) or a batch's output/error file (purpose batch_output, ids file-out-{order id} and file-err-{order id}).

sha256.description: Input files once processed: the SHA-256 of the whole file; null until the platform has read a file uploaded in parts. Absent on output and error files.

upload.description: A native multi-part upload still in progress.

FileList.description: The 100 most recent input files, newest first.

Metadata.description: Up to 16 string pairs, returned on the batch. Keys the platform reads are documented below; others are kept as given.

revision.description: Full commit of the model. Without it, the commit main names when the batch is created is pinned.

model.description: Hugging Face org/name; overrides the first line's body.model.

max_price_usd.description: Price ceiling in USD: a batch whose reserved price is higher is refused with 402 price_above_max and nothing is reserved.

reliquary_grader.description: Makes the batch an evaluation: every line carries a top-level reference and each completion is graded against it. Scores are on the native order (GET /api/v1/dataset-orders/{order id}, order.evaluation).

CreateBatch.description: Quotes the file and places the order in one call; the reserved price is the worst case (every line generates max_tokens for each of its n samples).

endpoint.description: The url of the file's lines (400 endpoint_mismatch otherwise).

completion_window.description: 24h to 168h. When it passes, a running batch stops and what was verified is delivered (status expired).

RequestCounts.description: total counts every line of the file; completed the lines that have all their samples; failed the refused lines and, once the batch has ended, the lines short of samples.

Batch.description: The id is batch_{order id}; the native order is GET /api/v1/dataset-orders/{order id} (price_usd, refunded_usd, progress and, for an evaluation, evaluation).

errors.description: A failed batch: errors.data[0].code gives the reason.

status.description: validating: reserved, waiting to start; in_progress: miners are generating; finalizing: exporting (and grading, for an evaluation); completed: delivered; expired: the window passed, what was verified is delivered; cancelling / cancelled; failed: ended without a delivery.

error_file_id.description: Set when lines were refused or some lines are short of samples.

RequestLine.description: One line of an input file. custom_id is unique in the file. Every usable line uses the same endpoint and the same temperature, top_p, top_k, min_p, max_tokens, seed and n (422 mixed_sampling otherwise). A line that cannot be used goes to the error file; the rest still runs. reference is required with metadata.reliquary_grader (or the native grader) and refused without it.

body.description: An OpenAI request body. Accepted: model, messages or prompt, tools, chat_template_kwargs, temperature (>0, <=4, default 1), top_p (default 1), top_k (0 or -1 for none), min_p, max_tokens or max_completion_tokens (16-131,072, default 4,096), seed, n (1-64). user, metadata, store, parallel_tool_calls and service_tier are ignored; stream, logprobs, stop, penalties, logit_bias, response_format, tool_choice, echo, suffix and best_of only at their neutral value; any other field is refused.

reference.description: The expected answer of an evaluation line.

OutputLine.description: A line of the output file, in OpenAI's batch output format: the n samples of an input line are the choices of its body, in sample order; finish_reason is stop or length.

ErrorLine.description: A line of the error file: refused lines first (with their file line number), then the lines that did not receive all their samples (with prompt_index).
